places.name: Masfout Oasis
places.description: A green farming oasis in Ajman's Masfout enclave, fed by water from the Hajar Mountains, with palms, trees and crops between rocky hills. Cooler than the coast and a good base for easy hikes; about 90 minutes from Ajman city, near Hatta.

places.name: Flamingo Beach
places.description: Free public beach on the RAK corniche, recognisable by two giant flamingo statues at the entrance. Calm, shallow water good for small children, plus kayaking, paddleboarding, a floodlit beach-volleyball court, cafés and easy parking.

places.name: RAK Nature's Treasures
places.description: Private natural-history museum with more than 2,500 gemstones, fossils, shells, insects and taxidermy, plus a cactus garden, salt room, reptile room, greenhouse, turtle and fish ponds, flamingo wetland and a petting zoo with miniature goats.

places.name: Al Hili Oasis
places.description: The northernmost oasis of Al Ain, part of the UNESCO sites: about 40,000 date palms on 252 farmed plots, an old falaj irrigation channel, two watchtowers and an early-1800s fortified house. Shaded paths for a quiet walk and photos.
